phase_name: Rebuild literature-briefing.sh global mode on filtered terms

objectives.description: Source literature-term-match.sh, compute FILTERED_TERMS verbatim per literature-coverage-delta.sh's pattern
Empty-filtered-terms fallback to raw single-query call with stderr notice
Replace single --project call with --multi filtered-term call
Extend shape-aware parser to read total_matched with results|length fallback
Pin seg_count/coverage_count/requested_count to de-duplicated pre-top_n total

approaches_tried.approach: Sizing FILTERED_TERMS via ${#FILTERED_TERMS[@]} directly after mapfile from filter_terms()
approaches_tried.reason: filter_terms() prints exactly one blank line (not zero lines) when every term is filtered out, so mapfile captures a 1-element array holding an empty string rather than a 0-element array; the empty-filtered-terms fallback never triggered for an all-stop-word query. Fixed by stripping blank entries from FILTERED_TERMS before sizing it.
